_about: Belt systems for belt drives (ADR-063, ADR-064). Every value here was supplied by the researcher on 2026-11-02 with its source. A null value is a required field that is not known yet: the lab shows it as 'unknown' and never guesses it. Do not add a pitch diameter, centre distance or other derived value here: they are computed. R18 (ADR-115): from 2026-11-12 only the McMaster-Carr entries (vendor McMaster-Carr) are offered for a new choice; every earlier entry is marked not_sourceable with its evidence and still builds stored bodies.

systems.allowable_working_tension_derivation: 111 N per 25.4 mm width = 4.37 N/mm x 10 mm
systems.breaking_strength_derivation: 86 N per mm width x 10 mm
sources: SDP-SI Technical Section, Table 3 'Allowable Working Tension' for 2 mm GT: 111 N (25 lbf) per inch of width
Ondrives GT2 catalog: breaking strength 86 N per 1 mm width
systems.notes: SDP-SI states that narrow belts (under 1 in) must be derated, so 44 N is optimistic. Generic belt construction is unverified.
systems.not_sourceable: researcher's rule 2026-11-12 (session R18, ADR-115): every pulley and belt of this body comes from McMaster-Carr only (GT pulleys with a finished 1/4 in bore; closed neoprene GT belts); this entry is not a McMaster part
